guarantees.claim: When reg_state_valid is low, reg_state_tl elements are driven to all-zero bits.

assumptions.claim: The consumer of reg_state_tl must observe reg_state_valid and ignore reg_state_tl when valid is low.
assumptions.risk: If the consumer uses reg_state_tl as valid data when reg_state_valid is deasserted, zero-data could corrupt digest/state computation, leading to functional failure or potential security bypass.

uncertain_points.claim: If parameter Share exceeds the declared dimensions of reg_state or reg_state_tl, the for-loop will index beyond array bounds, causing out-of-bounds reads/writes.
uncertain_points.cond: Share > actual array depth of reg_state or reg_state_tl
uncertain_points.risk: Array index out of bounds may lead to unknown/undefined behavior in simulation, synthesis latch inference, or data corruption from non-existent memory locations.
